verdict.rationale: Luma publishes llms.txt files at both lumalabs.ai/llms.txt and docs.lumalabs.ai/llms.txt, the latter confirmed by a probe returning HTTP 200. Any docs page can be fetched as markdown by appending .md, and the markdown mirror carries per-endpoint OpenAPI definitions indexed by llms.txt. The current Agents API docs add "Copy Markdown" and assistant-open links. Missing for 10: an llms.txt confirmed for the current Agents API docs generation (the indexed docs.lumalabs.ai set is labeled legacy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.lumalabs.ai/llms.txt # Luma APIs Documentation
